blockers.behavior: Whole-source contextual checks beyond early modifier lists are not implemented by a repository-owned source validator.
blockers.impact: false accept if structural matching is misused as full source validation
blockers.why: These parser-valid forms can fail compilation; generic EBNF matching intentionally accepts contextual-invalid fixtures.
blockers.closure: Add a repository source/derivation-to-context representation and ordered folding-aware validation for the listed areas; preserve early modifier checks and distinguish checked from unsupported rules. Do not use PHP lint as the implementation.

blockers.behavior: Diagnostic predicate isolation and indirect/deferred checks are not established by function-family links.
area: zend_compile.c direct diagnostic sites listed below
blockers.impact: possible false accept/reject at contextual/folding layer; no observed mismatch in current matrices
blockers.why: One family witness does not prove every diagnostic guard, traversal order or delegated helper.
blockers.closure: Attach a diagnostic-specific positive/negative witness or justified out-of-scope disposition to each listed site; trace delegated helpers in the named files, separating class loading, actual type compatibility and runtime constant evaluation from source-only checks.

blockers.behavior: Normalized AST/derivation equivalence within aggregate interpolated-string/heredoc tokens is not measured.
blockers.impact: possible structural disagreement; bounded whole-source acceptance currently agrees
blockers.why: The production matcher sees one string token. Recursive acceptance does not expose embedded operand spans to the structure matrix.
blockers.closure: Expose an audit-only embedded-token/derivation view, then compare Zend encapsulation operand fingerprints for the existing depth-six matrix; preserve the public aggregate-token contract.

blockers.behavior: Executable observations use PHP 8.5.10 rather than a build of the pinned PHP-8.5 revision.
blockers.impact: possible false accept/reject or structural disagreement if the pin differs in audited syntax paths
blockers.why: The three source hashes establish source identity, not executable identity.
blockers.closure: Build the exact pin with ext-ast and rerun the matrices, or document all parser/scanner/compiler changes between the release and pin with targeted evidence.
